hook: Slip painted eggs into enemy units, then watch the shared clock strike and your chicks heave their hosts apart.
loop: Lay Eggs in enemies likely to survive three attacks.
Grow the clock with Wind and Chime, or grow your Brood.
Each Chime hatches Chicks that Heave; Ottilie re-lays every strike.

growth.line: Brood grows permanently turn by turn; most power stays inside fights, exploding late as Chimes multiply.

feel.early: One egg a fight; small 2/2 chicks land.
feel.mid: Choose: speed up the clock or grow the brood.
feel.late: Capstones flood fights with Chimes, eggs and Heaves.

stars.why: Repeats Start of Combat on the hour, joining eggs and clock.
Doubles Chime effects beside it, so positioning matters every turn.
Two words of text that teach the whole tribe on turn one.

card_short.u01: Start of Combat: Lay an Egg in the enemy across.
card_short.u02: Dozes until the first Chime; Winds the clock 1.
card_short.u03: Sturdy front-liner; when it dies, Winds the clock 3.
card_short.u04: End of Turn: your Brood permanently grows +1/+1.
card_short.u05: Lays an Egg; earns gold when his Eggs hatch.
card_short.u07: Puts the enemy across to sleep and Lays in it.
card_short.u08: Hides as an Egg, hatches back at triple stats.
card_short.u09: Grows each turn; sell her to feed your Brood.
card_short.u10: Lays in friends; their Chicks copy the host's keywords.
card_short.u11: Can't attack; clock strikes every 2 attacks while he lives.
card_short.u12: Chime effects of units beside it trigger an extra time.
card_short.u13: Chime: Lay in a random enemy, twice a fight.
card_short.u14: First Chick each fight becomes a copy of its host.
card_short.u15: Hunker; sleeps until the 7th Chime, growing +4/+4 each Chime.
card_short.u16: First Chime: other Clockworks and Brood grow permanently.
card_short.u17: Other Clockworks' Start of Combat effects repeat at each Chime.
card_short.u18: Each of your Eggs hatches two extra Chicks.
card_short.x01: Marker on a host; hatches at the next Chime.
card_short.x02: Brood-sized Clockwork that lands on your side and Heaves.
card_short.x03: Rules notes: what counts as a Chime effect.

builds.name: The May Clutch
builds.line: Hens, Kasimir and Brood growth into Red-Mouth and Ottilie; keep slots free.

builds.name: The Tower clock
builds.line: Winders, Old Unruh and Chime units around the Bellows for most strikes.

builds.name: The Changeling house
builds.line: Rohrsang and Wechselbalg turn your best unit into foster copies.

liked: A shared clock and eggs inside enemy units: no tribe plays like it.
Ottilie joins eggs and clock; the Bellows makes positioning matter.
worries: Hawk-Barred Hen plus Ottilie keeps one enemy asleep all fight.
Runaway lines: Herald of Spring beside Bellows, Red-Mouth with Ottilie and Hens.
changed: Bellows now repeats once-a-fight Chimes like the Herald's; several Bellows stack.
Clock strikes only after normal attacks, so Chime attacks can't chain strikes.
Kasimir's gold capped at 2 a turn; Gernegroß keeps his slot, hatches first.
verdict: Built for players who love big in-fight combo moments: eggs planted in enemies, then the clock strikes.
